column1: #build label(pump_station) start(1; 1) message(A powered screw pump that lifts water or magma one tile to the north. Msu is directional: it draws from the tile to its south and ejects to the tile to its north
column2: so aim the pump before you build. Power flows from the water wheel west to east through the axle and gear; link a lever to the gear assembly to switch the whole train on and off.)

column1: title: Powered screw pump station (directional machinery)
tags: build, machine, screw pump, power, water
description: A minimal powered pump station showing Dwarf Fortress machine tokens. Msu is a screw pump that ejects to the NORTH (its variants Msk/Msm/Msh eject east/south/west)
column2: so it draws water or magma from the tile to its south and pushes it to the tile to its north. Power comes from Mw
column3: a water wheel built over flowing water; it feeds Mh
column6: a gear assembly. The gear is the junction you link a lever (Tl) to so you can engage or disengage the pump without deconstructing it. Placement rules the blueprint cannot enforce: the water wheel must sit over moving water
column7: the pump's south intake tile must hold the liquid you want to raise
column8: and the machines must form a connected power path. Rotate the pump direction by choosing the matching token
column9: and lengthen the drive train by painting more Mh axle tiles between the wheel and the gear.
